transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I... I guess I'm just here because I'm tired. It's been a year of trying to get someone to listen to me about my dad's lab results. Someone in the system is messing with them—changing things, holding parts back. I draw blood for a living, I know what I'm looking at. But every doctor, even my own family, they just keep telling me the numbers are fine. They aren't. The chart doesn't match what I saw. It's just... wearing me down.
Do you think someone is intentionally trying to deceive you or hide information from you about your dad's lab results?

I mean... yes. I've spent the whole year trying to prove it. Someone in the clinic system is definitely holding parts of it back. I saw the numbers, and the chart they put in the system just doesn't match. So... yeah. They are.
Do you think this is happening to you alone or could it be part of a larger conspiracy?
I... I don't know. I just know what I saw with his chart. I haven't really... looked into anyone else's. Just his.
Do you ever feel like people are out to get you or hiding things from you in other areas of your life, not just with your dad's medical records?
No. It's... it's just this. I still go to work. I do my shifts at the clinic, I pay my bills... I take care of myself. Everything else is just normal. It's only his records.
Have you ever felt like something similar is happening with your own medical records or information?
No. I... no. I haven't noticed anything with mine. My records are fine.
Have you ever felt like something similar is happening with anyone else you know, like a friend or another family member?
No. Just... just my dad. I haven't noticed anything with anyone else.
Have you ever had thoughts that someone is following you or watching you?
No. I... no. Nobody is following me. I just go to work and come home.
Do you think your belief about your dad's lab results being altered is something that might not be true, or are you completely certain it's true?

I know it's true. I... I know what I saw. 

Everyone keeps telling me the numbers are fine. The doctors, my family... but they aren't. For the past year, I've just been trying to prove that someone in the clinic system is changing them, or holding parts of his results back. 

The chart doesn't match. I'm certain of that. It's just... it's really wearing me down.
Have you ever had thoughts that someone is plotting against you outside of your dad's medical records?
No. Um... no. Just what I told you. It's just his chart. Nothing else.
Have you ever had thoughts that you have special powers or abilities that no one else has?
No. I don't... I don't have anything like that. I'm just a phlebotomist. I just draw blood. I don't have any special powers.
How certain are you that someone is altering your dad's lab results?

I already told you. I know it's true. I'm... I'm completely certain. I know what I saw on that chart, and it doesn't match what they're telling me. I've been trying to prove it for a year now, and... I just know it's happening. No matter what anyone says.
Have you considered the possibility that you might be misinterpreting the lab results?

No. I... I look at lab results every day for my job. I'm not misinterpreting them. 

I know my family and all the doctors keep telling me the numbers are fine, but... they're not. The chart just doesn't match what I saw. Someone in the clinic system is changing things, or holding parts of it back. I've been trying to prove it for a year now, and... it's just really wearing me down. Having to defend myself. But I know what I saw.
Would you change your mind about your dad's lab results being altered if an investigation found no evidence of tampering?

No. I wouldn't. 

I know what I saw. I've spent a year looking into this. An investigation... if they didn't find anything, it just means whoever is changing the numbers or hiding the files is really good at covering their tracks. I'm the one who saw the original chart. I know what's happening in the system, even if they won't admit it.
